summary.text: Scott Dibble is a Democratic state senator who represents District 61 and is the only candidate on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for the seat.
A legislator since 2001, he chairs the Senate Transportation Finance and Policy Committee.

paragraphs.text: Dibble attended the University of Minnesota and the University of St. Thomas, and his professional experience includes working as a community organizer and as a staffer to Minneapolis Councilperson Dore Mead.
Dibble served in the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 60B, from 2001 to 2003 and in the State Senate representing District 60 from 2003 to 2013; he has represented District 61 since 2013.
His 2025-2026 committee assignments are Capital Investment, Energy and Utilities Finance and Policy, Taxes, and Transportation Finance and Policy, which he chairs.
